label: EXPLORATORY: Stage 1 room test of the lower-edge channel (plan sections 4.0, 4.1, 7), computed outside the gate on saved gate artifacts; not a gated output; changes no pre-registered rule; no BCA band, calibrator, threshold, dose or BCA update was used (stand-ins and oracles only)

marks_text.futility: seeds 0 and 1 run first; if the perfect band beats the matched even pull by less than 5 points in strong current on both seeds, stop and go to plan section 4.5 (seeds 2-4 are not run). A missing difference counts as less than 5 points: the perfect band not finite, the even pull with no matched arm, or the seed stopped by a failed check (a), (b) or (e); futility.json names the reason per seed (change A8). The look refuses until both seeds have a verified values.json or stop.json
marks_text.keeps_improvement: recorded conditions: perfect band >= no caution - 2 and >= cloned actor + 25 (pooled means); big waves and big kicks: perfect band >= no caution - 3 (pooled means)
marks_text.pooled: means over seeds 0-4; every mark needs every seed (a missing or failed seed fails the mark). The pooled look refuses until futility.json says continue and every seed has a verified values.json or stop.json
marks_text.prediction_not_a_mark: perfect band 60-100 points in strong current (cap-at-80% ceiling 101.8, full-log actor 84.6); matched controls within -5 to +10 of no caution. Written by the plan for its literal oracle; kept unchanged
marks_text.recovery: in strong current the perfect band is at least 49.5 points above no caution (pooled mean of the paired difference; half of check 2's 98.9-point harm)
marks_text.room: in strong current the perfect band beats each gating control (even_pull, push_less, random_1, random_2, each at its matched strength) by at least 20 points (pooled mean of the paired difference), and that difference is positive in at least 4 of 5 seeds, for each control
